╭─ What may test-writer do? ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│  tiers                                                                                                                         │
│ ❯ [x] read     files, searches, listings, the notebook — every agent has this                                                  │
│   [x] write    edit files · it works in its own copy of the tree and hands back a patch                                        │
│   [x] execute  run commands · in the same copy                                                                                 │
│   [ ] web      fetch pages and search                                                                                          │
│   ▸ with write or execute, test-writer is a writer: it works in its own copy, its patch comes to a card                        │
│  tools this session registered, by tier — it gets only what is ticked                                                          │
│   [x] glob             read     paths by pattern                                                                               │
│       quality_gate     read     ⊘ "quality_gate" is for a profile that changes nothing; one granting write or execute works i… │
│   [x] read_file        read     one file, or a run of its lines                                                                │
│   [x] search           read     text across the tree                                                                           │
│   [x] edit_file        write    a change to part of a file                                                                     │
│   [x] write_file       write    a new file, or one written whole                                                               │
│   [x] execute_command  execute  one shell command                                                                              │
│   [ ] web_fetch        web      one page, read as text                                                                         │
│       always                    navigation · notebook · skills — every child has these                                         │
│ [space] toggle · [a] all/none · [enter] select (9) · [esc] cancel                                                              │
